bugs.text: Entry group timer g.t is never incremented, so only the delay-0 Boss groups ever fly in; the other 36 enemies stay 'pending' (invisible, unhittable). Slots 31-39 are also in no group.

Because of the pending enemies, filling never ends (no dives, no breathing, no tractor beam, no captures) and the stage-clear check never passes: after the 4 Bosses are shot the game soft-locks on stage 1 with an empty sky (screenshots 4-play-*, 5-end).
All enemies start with hp 1, so the Boss dies in one hit and is always drawn in its purple 'damaged' colour.
Rescue sets only dualL; the dual fighter (two sprites, double shot) needs both dualL and dualR, so a single rescue gives nothing; a hit kills both halves.
Challenging stage: the 10,000 PERFECT bonus is never added, escaped enemies count as dead, and no NUMBER OF HITS / bonus screen is shown after the stage.
Game over only at ships<0, so the player gets 4 ships instead of 3.
Second reserve ship drawn at y 282-291, mostly off the 288 px canvas.
Stage badges ignore the arcade denominations; just 1-6 identical flags that wrap.
Fires only on frames where frame%10===0, so short Space taps are often dropped.
Being captured plays the player explosion sound and draws an explosion at the player's position.
Boss dive score counts escorts that have already been destroyed.

summary: A compact, readable file with a correct fixed-timestep loop, a good starfield, title screen, HUD, localStorage high score, sound and mute, and code for most Galaga mechanics (curved dives with wrap-around, Boss escorts, tractor beam, capture, rescue, challenging stages). But one missing line (the entry-group timer is never advanced) breaks the game: only the 4 Boss Galaga ever fly in, they die in one shot (hp starts at 1) and show their damaged colour, the formation never finishes filling, so nothing ever dives or uses the tractor beam, and the stage can never be cleared. The play-test screenshots show the 4 Bosses, 300 points, then two Bosses swaying until the end. Behind that soft-lock is more broken logic: the dual fighter needs two rescues to appear, the PERFECT bonus is never paid, there is no hit-count screen after challenging stages, badges ignore the denominations, and the player gets 4 ships. It looks like Galaga for a few seconds, then plays like a 4-target shooting gallery that stops.
